It is used for separating two λ-terms M, N provided that their structure is sufficiently different (depending on the notion of separation under consideration). We show that when M 6vnf N this difference can be Böhmed out via an appropriate head context, even when M and N have a similar structure (i.e. M vhnf N ). 4.1 Morris Separators We start by providing a notion of Morris separator, that is a sequence σ witnessing the fact that M 6vnf N for λ-terms M and N such that M is β-normal and M vhnf N holds.
